title: Unit 5 Consolidation
goal: Review opinion verbs, verbs of doubt and denial, no es que… sino que… and possibility markers, and read a text about Octavio Paz and his book of essays.

items: Review opinion verbs and verbs of doubt and denial, with and without no.
Review no es que… sino que… and the possibility markers for hedging an opinion.
Read a text about the writer Octavio Paz and his book of essays.
I can say that I do not think, doubt or deny something, with the right mood.
I can correct a reason with no es que and the subjunctive, and sino que and the indicative.
I can hedge an opinion and disagree politely.
I can read a short text about Octavio Paz and his book of essays.
